summary: Vercel Drives now reads files up to 6x faster. The update improves cold-read performance. A new read-ahead algorithm uses your application’s access patterns to load data from persistent storage before it’s needed, reducing the time your code spends waiting. All drives get this update automatically, with no SDK upgrade or configuration changes required. Read pricing is unchanged. Learn more in the Vercel Drives documentation . Read more

title: Speed Insights now measures soft navigations
summary: Speed Insights now measures soft navigations: client-side route changes that update page content without a full reload. This means you can now track performance as users move through your app, not just on full-page loads. Speed Insights captures LCP, FCP, INP, and CLS for soft navigations and includes these measurements in your Real Experience Score. TTFB is not captured because there is no new document request. Soft-navigation tracking is enabled by default for all projects
author: Vercel AI
